versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֵלָ֑יו בְּהַעֲלֹֽתְךָ֙ אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֔ת אֶל־מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמְּנוֹרָ֔ה יָאִ֖ירוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת הַנֵּרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”
controles.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
controles.livre: Fala a Arão, e dize-lhe: Quando acenderes as lâmpadas, as sete lâmpadas iluminarão de frente à frente do candelabro.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶל־מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמְּנוֹרָ֔ה הֶעֱלָ֖ה נֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E Arão o fez assim; que acendeu em frente do candelabro suas lâmpadas, como o SENHOR o mandou a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וְזֶ֨ה מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה הַמְּנֹרָה֙ מִקְשָׁ֣ה זָהָ֔ב עַד־יְרֵכָ֥הּ עַד־פִּרְחָ֖הּ מִקְשָׁ֣ה הִ֑וא כַּמַּרְאֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃פ

controles.web: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work: according to the pattern which Yahweh had shown Moses, so he made the lamp stand.
controles.kjv: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the Lord had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
controles.livre: E esta era a feitura do candelabro: de ouro lavrado a martelo; desde seu pé até suas flores era lavrado a martelo: conforme o modelo que o SENHOR mostrou a Moisés, assim fez o candelabro.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: קַ֚ח אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְטִהַרְתָּ֖ אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
controles.kjv: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
controles.livre: Toma aos levitas dentre os filhos de Israel, e expia-os.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹֽה־תַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְטַֽהֲרָ֔ם הַזֵּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֵ֣י חַטָּ֑את וְהֶעֱבִ֤ירוּ תַ֨עַר֙ עַל־כָּל־בְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְכִבְּס֥וּ בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְהִטֶּהָֽרוּ׃

controles.web: You shall do this to them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
controles.kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
controles.livre: E assim lhes farás para expiá-los: esparge sobre eles a água da expiação, e face passar a navalha sobre toda sua carne, e lavarão suas roupas, e serão expiados.

versos.hebraico: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ פַּ֣ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֔ר וּמִנְחָת֔וֹ סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן וּפַר־שֵׁנִ֥י בֶן־בָּקָ֖ר תִּקַּ֥ח לְחַטָּֽאת׃

controles.web: Then let them take a young bull, and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.
controles.kjv: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
controles.livre: Logo tomarão um novilho, com sua oferta de cereais de flor de farinha amassada com azeite; e tomarás outro novilho para expiação.

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהִ֨קְהַלְתָּ֔ אֶֽת־כָּל־עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
controles.livre: E farás chegar os levitas diante do tabernáculo do testemunho, e juntarás toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel;

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְסָמְכ֧וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: You shall present the Levites before Yahweh. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,
controles.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
controles.livre: E quando haverás feito chegar os levitas diante do SENHOR, porão os filhos de Israel suas mãos sobre os levitas;

versos.hebraico: וְהֵנִיף֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֤ם תְּנוּפָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָי֕וּ לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Yahweh for a wave offering, on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lord for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the Lord.
controles.livre: E oferecerá Arão os levitas diante do SENHOR em oferta dos filhos de Israel, e servirão no ministério do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְהַלְוִיִּם֙ יִסְמְכ֣וּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַפָּרִ֑ים וַ֠עֲשֵׂה אֶת־הָאֶחָ֨ד חַטָּ֜את וְאֶת־הָאֶחָ֤ד עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.
controles.kjv: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the Lord, to make an atonement for the Levites.
controles.livre: E os levitas porão suas mãos sobre as cabeças dos novilhos: e oferecerás um por expiação, e o outro em holocausto ao SENHOR, para expiar os levitas.

versos.hebraico: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: You shall set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E farás presentear os levitas diante de Arão, e diante de seus filhos, e os oferecerás em oferta ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
controles.kjv: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
controles.livre: Assim separarás os levitas dentre os filhos de Israel; e serão meus os levitas

versos.hebraico: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־כֵן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְטִֽהַרְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם תְּנוּפָֽה׃

controles.web: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting: and you shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.
controles.kjv: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
controles.livre: E depois disso virão os levitas a ministrar no tabernáculo do testemunho: os expiarás pois, e os oferecerás em oferta.

versos.hebraico: כִּי֩ נְתֻנִ֨ים נְתֻנִ֥ים הֵ֨מָּה֙ לִ֔י מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תַּחַת֩ פִּטְרַ֨ת כָּל־רֶ֜חֶם בְּכ֥וֹר כֹּל֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָקַ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖ם לִֽי׃

controles.web: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.
controles.kjv: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
controles.livre: Porque inteiramente são a mim dados os levitas dentre os filhos de Israel, em lugar de todo aquele que abre madre; ei-los tomado para mim em lugar dos primogênitos de todos os filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לִ֤י כָל־בְּכוֹר֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּי֗וֹם הַכֹּתִ֤י כָל־בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם הִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי אֹתָ֖ם לִֽי׃

controles.web: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.
controles.kjv: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
controles.livre: Porque meu é todo primogênito nos filhos de Israel, tanto de homens como de animais; desde o dia que eu feri todo primogênito na terra do Egito, os santifiquei para mim.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶקַּח֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֥חַת כָּל־בְּכ֖וֹר בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E tomei os levitas em lugar de todos os primogênitos nos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶתְּנָ֨ה אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֜ם נְתֻנִ֣ים׀ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּלְבָנָ֗יו מִתּוֹךְ֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לַעֲבֹ֞ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּלְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֨א יִהְיֶ֜ה בִּבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נֶ֔גֶף בְּגֶ֥שֶׁת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”
controles.kjv: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
controles.livre: E eu dei em presente os levitas a Arão e a seus filhos dentre os filhos de Israel, para que sirvam o ministério dos filhos de Israel no tabernáculo do testemunho, e reconciliem aos filhos de Israel; porque não haja praga nos filhos de Israel, chegando os filhos de Israel ao santuário.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וְכָל־עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַלְוִיִּ֑ם כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם כֵּן־עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
controles.kjv: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
controles.livre: E Moisés, e Arão, e toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, fizeram dos levitas conforme todas as coisas que mandou o SENHOR a Moisés acerca dos levitas; assim fizeram deles os filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽתְחַטְּא֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם וַֽיְכַבְּסוּ֙ בִּגְדֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּ֨נֶף אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְכַפֵּ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְטַהֲרָֽם׃

controles.web: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before Yahweh; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
controles.kjv: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the Lord; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
controles.livre: E os levitas se purificaram, e lavaram suas roupas; e Arão os ofereceu em oferta diante do SENHOR, e fez Arão expiação por eles para purificá-los.

versos.hebraico: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֞ן בָּ֣אוּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם לַעֲבֹ֤ד אֶת־עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה֙ עַל־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם כֵּ֖ן עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron, and before his sons: as Yahweh had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
controles.kjv: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
controles.livre: E assim vieram depois os levitas para servir em seu ministério no tabernáculo do testemunho, diante de Arão e diante de seus filhos: da maneira que mandou o SENHOR a Moisés acerca dos levitas, assim fizeram com eles.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: זֹ֖את אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַלְוִיִּ֑ם מִבֶּן֩ חָמֵ֨שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה יָבוֹא֙ לִצְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א בַּעֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: “This is that which belongs to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;
controles.kjv: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
controles.livre: Isto quanto aos levitas: de vinte e cinco anos acima entrarão a fazer seu ofício no serviço do tabernáculo do testemunho:

versos.hebraico: וּמִבֶּן֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב מִצְּבָ֣א הָעֲבֹדָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲבֹ֖ד עֽוֹד׃

controles.web: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting on the work, and shall serve no more,
controles.kjv: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
controles.livre: Mas desde os cinquenta anos voltarão do ofício de seu ministério, e nunca mais servirão:

versos.hebraico: וְשֵׁרֵ֨ת אֶת־אֶחָ֜יו בְּאֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לִשְׁמֹ֣ר מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וַעֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַעֲבֹ֑ד כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּמִשְׁמְרֹתָֽם׃פ

controles.web: but shall minister with their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall do no service. You shall do thus to the Levites concerning their duties.”
controles.kjv: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
controles.livre: Porém servirão com seus irmãos no tabernáculo do testemunho, para fazer a guarda, ainda que não servirão no ministério. Assim farás dos levitas quanto a seus ofícios.
